== Biography ==
George Robert Glasgow is named as the son of  the late James Glasgow, a minor at James's death, in an 1837 court notice in the Baltimore Gazette & Daily Advertiser.<ref>Baltimore Gazette & Daily Advertiser, Friday, 23 June 1837,  Volume 87, Issue 14465, Page 4, Column 5. Image found on {{FindAGrave|105585399|sameas="no"}}</ref> 

George doesn't appear to have married.
